text:
alice: Following up on the postmortemwe need a single source of truth for action owners, JIRA links, and the RACI table before we close the PM. Who will take each item?
ben: I'll pick up the cache retention fix and the performance regression evals. Will open a ticket and add ACs.
carla: I'll own the runbook / rollout checklist and the canary steps. Will prepare the ops play.
diane: I'll be the SRE reviewer and backup for oncall escalations. Diane=Review in RACI.
evan: I'll do the incident-pattern mapping and attach correlated logs + grep snippets. I already found two similar incidents in Jan/Feb.
pm-bot: Jira RW-4788 created by @ben - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-4788
ben: RW-4788: Reduce KV retention window, add eviction backpressure, and add perf/regression eval. Assignee=ben. ETA PR by 2026-04-12.
carla: RW-4789 created for runbook + canary playbook by @carla - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-4789
diane: Suggested acceptance criteria for RW-4788: under synthetic workload A, kv_cache_size 95th pct remains within baseline +/-10% for 48h. Canary passes 72h with zero OOMs.
ben: Adding ACs. Eval prompt I'll use: 
```
# eval: long-prefix-stress
generate sequences with repeated long prefixes up to 1024 tokens, record kv_cache_size and eviction counts every 15s
```
evan: Grep/awk snippets I'll attach to RW-4788 under "Diagnostics":
```
zgrep "kv_cache_size" /var/log/*/service.log | awk '{print $1,$4,$7}' | sort -k3 -n | tail -n 50
awk -F"," '/eviction/ || /oom/ {print $1,$2,$5}' /var/log/incidents/*.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr
```
alice: Evan, please also add a short prose summary linking incidents 2026-01-19 and 2026-02-23 and a one-line likelihood estimate (low/medium/high).
evan: Done, attached to RW-4788 -> Diagnostics. Linked RW-4230 and RW-4301.
carla: RACI proposal (I'll paste into both tickets): Ben=R (code + evals), Carla=A (runbook + canary owner), Evan=C (diagnostics), Diane=C (SRE review), Alice=I (PM). Anyone object?
diane: Looks good. I'll run through the canary checklist and sign off before rollout.
ben: Handing docs and the canary stub to @carla; I remain assignee for the bugfix PR.
infra-bot: Canary scheduled on rw-dedicated-prod by @carla at 2026-04-15T04:00Z
alice: Proposed timeline: PR by 2026-04-12, internal review 2026-04-13, staged canary 2026-04-15-17, close follow-up by 2026-04-22 if canary stable. If any regressions, we open a follow-on deep-dive ticket.
ben: Ack :thumbsup: I'll aim for that PR date.
carla: Ack. I'll publish the canary playbook in RW-4789 and ping infra for the isolated pool.
pm-bot: Reminder created: PM follow-up RW-4788 sync - 2026-04-14 09:00 UTC
alice: Let's keep updates in the tickets and only post major status here. If anyone needs extra time call it out now.
ben: All good on my side unless we hit a perf regression during pre-merge tests.
evan: I'll re-run the correlation queries after the PR lands and update the ticket.
carla: Will add a short rollback checklist to RW-4789 and confirm monitoring alerts to watch during canary.
diane: I'll schedule a 15m gating call right before canary start to confirm safety checks.
alice: Thanks all. Plan to close PM follow-up after RW-4788 & RW-4789 meet ACs and canary passes.
